Here is the part-of-speech analysis for the sentence: "While I was walking through the park, I stumbled upon an old, mysterious book that was hidden beneath a pile of leaves."

**Sentence Breakdown:**

1.  **While**: Subordinating Conjunction (introduces the dependent clause)
2.  **I**: Pronoun (Subject of the dependent clause)
3.  **was**: Verb (Auxiliary/Helping verb, past tense)
4.  **walking**: Verb (Present participle, main verb in the dependent clause)
5.  **through**: Preposition
6.  **the**: Determiner (Article)
7.  **park**: Noun (Object of the preposition "through")
8.  **,**: Punctuation
9.  **I**: Pronoun (Subject of the independent clause)
10. **stumbled**: Verb (Main verb, past tense)
11. **upon**: Preposition
12. **an**: Determiner (Article)
13. **old**: Adjective (Modifies "book")
14. **mysterious**: Adjective (Modifies "book")
15. **book**: Noun (Object of the preposition "upon")
16. **that**: Pronoun (Relative pronoun, subject of the relative clause)
17. **was**: Verb (Auxiliary/Helping verb, past tense)
18. **hidden**: Verb (Past participle, main verb in the relative clause)
19. **beneath**: Preposition
20. **a**: Determiner (Article)
21. **pile**: Noun (Object of the preposition "beneath")
22. **of**: Preposition
23. **leaves**: Noun (Object of the preposition "of")
24. **.**: Punctuation

***

The fastest land animal in the world is the **cheetah**.
